exposure: Complete hydatidiform mole with coexistent fetus (CHMCF)
cohort: A 33-year-old multiparous woman with suspected CHMCF and subsequent diagnosis of high-risk GTN from International Federation of Gynecology and Obstetrics (FIGO) scoring.
finding: Complete hydatidiform mole with coexistent fetus (CHMCF) can result in high-risk gestational trophoblastic neoplasm (GTN) during pregnancy, necessitating a treatment strategy based on FIGO scoring.
